description.text: Evaluation and Admission Procedures 1. Application Review Applications submitted with all the information and materials correct and completed will be reviewed by Beihang University. 2. Integrative Test Applicants who have passed the Application Review will be admitted to the integrative test. The method and time of the integrative test will be informed in advance. 3. Pre-admission Notice 4. Official Admission Result The admission decision is based on a comprehensive evaluation of the application review and integrative test. Tuition Fee: RMB 30,000 Yuan /Yr. Insurance:RMB3,200 Yuan /4 Yr. Study Period: 4 Years. The maximum period is 6 years Accommodation International Students Dormitory, double room with a bathroom: 750 Yuan/Month, per bed* * Accommodation fees may be adjusted. Bills of water and electricity are not included.

duration.text: The Aerospace Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA 2. Applicants should have the equivalent of a high school education 3. Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school 4. Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general 5. Applicants should have good command of English and the ability to take courses in English; Applicants are required to submit the certificates of 90 or more in TOEFL, 5.5 or more in IELTS or any other proofs about English level. All the applicants should pass the English Level Test at the beginning of the first semester in BUAA
